title: Builder BLD-107: Mobile sheets

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-107.

detail:
B1 Shell, pass BLD-107 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-107). Mobile sheets. Scope: components/builder/mobile. Build: Bottom bar: Outline, Add, Tune, Vera. Bottom sheet with the same two layers; 44px targets. Done when: Every Layer 1 and Layer 2 control is reachable at 390 wide. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), a11y ratchet, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-105, BLD-106. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Phone layout under the shared sm breakpoint (600): a bottom bar with Outline, Add (arrives with BLD-202), Tune and Vera (opens the command bar's Ask Vera), 44px targets; the outline and Tune open as bottom sheets carrying both Tune layers, so every Layer 1 and Layer 2 control is reachable at 390 wide (rails table proves a rail opens at 390).
